data.exact_reserve_text: The table below shows changes in the insurance contract liabilities and assets from the beginning of the period to the end of the period. ... Change in estimates of prior year provisions Gross provisions (78,675) Reinsurance assets 62,733 Net (15,942). The change in claims outstanding includes the impact of release of net reserves for claims incurred on the prior years of GBP 15.9m (2023: strengthening of GBP 80.4m). These net reserve movements are stated net of the protection provided by the LPT.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Provided additional protection for 2019 and prior years of claims, allowing recovery of losses up to $450m group deterioration, and ceding surpluses. Net reserve movements are stated net of this protection.

named_events.loss_description: Exposures reviewed, reasonable provision made for identified claims. Further claims possible.
Exposures from conflict in the Middle East are not expected to be material for the Syndicate.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 78.675 million for 2024, representing a 5.50% reduction relative to opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development is influenced by the Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) with Enstar, which provides protection against deterioration and allows for the cession of surpluses on 2019 and prior accident years. The net release for prior years was GBP 15.9 million, after accounting for reinsurance. The Syndicate also continues to monitor exposures related to the Russia and Ukraine conflict and the Middle East conflict, for which reasonable provisions have been made.
raw_causal_phrases: The execution of a LPT with Enstar during 2022 has provided additional protection in terms of the reserves for all 2019 and prior years of claims.
This agreement provides protection against significant deterioration of prior accident year reserves up to $450m above the group reserves held at the time of the transaction.
Should surpluses develop on 2019 and prior accident years then these surpluses are also ceded under the LPT.
These net reserve movements are stated net of the protection provided by the LPT.

Exposures relating to the Russia and Ukraine conflict have been reviewed and Aspen has identified impacted policy holders and potential claims, and examined received claims. Although further claims resulting from the conflict are possible, reasonable provision for all claims identified to date have been made.
Exposures from conflict in the Middle East are not expected to be material for the Syndicate.

Aspen has cedants/insureds that have assets in Russia and Ukraine, and the Syndicate has run several scenarios to assess its potential exposure and it will continue to monitor these exposures closely. The exposures arise from aviation reinsurance exposures and credit and political risks and international crisis management insurance exposures.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is taken from the 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' line in Note 17, which explicitly states the gross movement. This figure differs from a calculation based on the claims development triangle, likely due to specific accounting adjustments or the nature of the LPT reinsurance arrangement.
